descriptionLong: The reflective drawstring bag REFLECT is a practical element of high-visibility protective clothing designed for professional use. Made of durable polyester, it enhances worker safety in low-light or high-risk environments. Equipped with strong drawstrings and a hook-and-loop closure, it allows for quick and convenient use. Ideal as a functional addition to PPE on construction sites, in transport or during road works. Compliant with international standard EN ISO 20471 – Protective clothing – High-visibility clothing for medium-risk situations, intended for professional use.

This calculated indication is based on reliable LCA data as published by Textile Exchange in their Material Snapshots 2016.
